## About
Marco's Garage is a neighborhood shop at 2889 W Valley Blvd in Alhambra. We do complete auto care, from brakes and alignment to electrical work and air conditioning, and we know Lexus, Toyota and classic cars well.
We like old cars as much as new ones. Our pictures page has Marco's Camaro, Tim's Bonneville, Bob's Old Bug, Helm's Truck and a custom pedal car. Our site is also dedicated to the loving memory of Jose Aguirre.
Customers give us 4.8 stars from 22 Google reviews, and reviewers keep coming back to the same word for Marco: honest. Give us a call or stop by during the week.

## Services
- Alignment: Wheel alignment to keep your car tracking straight.
- Brakes: Brake work for all makes and models.
- Electrical work: Tracking down and fixing electrical problems.
- Air Conditioning: Getting your air conditioning working again.
- Timing Belt: Timing belt replacement.
- Axles: Axle repair and replacement.
- Lexus and Toyota specialist: Lexus and Toyota are our specialty, along with classic cars.
- Old car front end custom clips and fabrication: One reviewer says we do old car front end custom clips, fabrication and just about full car restoration.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday. Call or stop by any time during those hours.

Q: What's the best way to reach you?
A: Give us a call at (626) 782-0220. That's the easiest way to get hold of us.

Q: Do you work on my car?
A: All makes and models are welcomed, and Lexus, Toyota and classic cars are our specialty. If it's something we can't take on, Marco will tell you straight and point you to a shop that can.
